meaning: (Qal) to pity, have compassion, spare, look upon with compassion

renderings.bsb: You must show him no pity
You must show her no pity
Yet I looked on them with pity

elsewhere.note: Also, don’t concern yourselves about your belongings, for the good of all the land of Egypt is yours.”
